infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HealthWay requires camera access for patient photo capture and medical document scanning.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HealthWay requires microphone access for voice-based clinical intake and teleconsultations.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: HealthWay requires location access to route emergency SOS alerts and identify nearby healthcare facilities.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: HealthWay requires location access to route emergency SOS alerts and track ambulance dispatches.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: HealthWay uses biometric authentication for secure patient and clinician logins.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow HealthWay to access your camera for patient photo capture and medical document scanning.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow HealthWay to access your microphone for voice intake and teleconsultations.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow HealthWay to access your location for emergency SOS alerts and ambulance dispatch tracking.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow HealthWay to access your location for emergency SOS dispatch and nearest facility routing.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow HealthWay to use Face ID for secure patient and staff authentication.
